title: reference date: quarter-close deadline day, festival continuing
lines: Woke up tired but resolute — the hardest day of the stretch, both at work and at home.
Delivered the quarter-close numbers at the office — a genuinely demanding, high-focus, largely deskbound day, minimal proper meals, running mostly on tea and quick snacks between calls.

Came home to a house still full of Ganesh Chaturthi guests and festivities — continued hosting into the evening, rich festive food, late night, significant cumulative sleep debt now over the past ten days. Reflected briefly with her husband before bed on how the month had layered two demanding things — quarter-close and the festival — on top of each other, and how she could feel it in her body: tired, a bit foggy, aware she'd been less consistent with her walks and medication timing this past week and a half than she'd like. Resolved, as she had in April, to reset once both the festival and the quarter-close eased — but honestly acknowledging tonight wasn't that night. Fell asleep late, still catching up on the week's accumulated exhaustion.
